steps.why: Deploy the validated model as a live endpoint to start serving predictions.
Freeze current score and input distributions to establish a reference for drift detection.
Arm PSI, CSI, latency, no-decision, and A/E alerts to monitor model performance and safety.

data.rationale: Deploying the model ensures it is available for real-time credit limit decisions. Baseline and alert rules provide continuous monitoring to detect drift and performance issues promptly.
